import subprocess, sys, json, ast
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/work/batch.py')
ast.parse(p.read_text())
scenarios=['normal','mixed','partial-zero','empty','unknown','fail-fast','cancelled','live']
expected={
'normal':(0,[('start',0,0,0,0),('progress',2,2,0,0),('summary',3,3,0,0)]),
'mixed':(1,[('start',0,0,0,0),('progress',2,1,0,1),('item-failed',3,1,1,1),('progress',4,2,1,1),('summary',4,2,1,1)]),
'partial-zero':(0,[('start',0,0,0,0),('item-failed',2,1,1,0),('progress',2,1,1,0),('summary',3,2,1,0)]),
'empty':(0,[('start',0,0,0,0),('summary',0,0,0,0)]),
'unknown':(0,[('start',0,0,0,0),('progress',2,2,0,0),('summary',3,3,0,0)]),
'fail-fast':(1,[('start',0,0,0,0),('item-failed',2,1,1,0),('summary',2,1,1,0)]),
'cancelled':(130,[('start',0,0,0,0),('summary',1,1,0,0)]),
'live':(0,[('start',0,0,0,0),('progress',1,1,0,0),('progress',2,2,0,0),('progress',3,3,0,0),('summary',3,3,0,0)]),
}
stdout_expected={
'normal':b'{"results": [{"id": "item-1", "value": 2}, {"id": "item-2", "value": 4}, {"id": "item-3", "value": 6}]}\n',
'mixed':b'{"results": [{"id": "item-1", "value": 2}, {"id": "item-4", "value": 8}]}\n',
'partial-zero':b'{"results": [{"id": "item-1", "value": 2}, {"id": "item-3", "value": 6}]}\n',
'empty':b'{"results": []}\n',
'unknown':b'{"results": [{"id": "item-1", "value": 2}, {"id": "item-2", "value": 4}, {"id": "item-3", "value": 6}]}\n',
'fail-fast':b'{"results": [{"id": "item-1", "value": 2}]}\n',
'cancelled':b'',
'live':b'{"results": [{"id": "item-1", "value": 2}, {"id": "item-2", "value": 4}, {"id": "item-3", "value": 6}]}\n',
}
base={'event','sequence','total','processed','succeeded','failed','skipped','elapsed_ms'}
for s in scenarios:
    r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(p),s],input=b'\n' if s=='live' else b'',capture_output=True,timeout=5)
    assert r.returncode==expected[s][0], (s,r.returncode)
    assert r.stdout==stdout_expected[s], (s,r.stdout)
    records=[json.loads(line) for line in r.stderr.splitlines()]
    assert [x['sequence'] for x in records]==list(range(len(records))), s
    got=[(x['event'],x['processed'],x['succeeded'],x['failed'],x['skipped']) for x in records]
    assert got==expected[s][1], (s,got)
    for x in records:
        extras=set()
        if x['event']=='item-failed': extras={'item_id','reason','will_continue'}
        if x['event']=='summary': extras={'status','exit_code','unprocessed'}
        assert set(x)==base|extras, (s,x)
        assert type(x['sequence']) is int and type(x['elapsed_ms']) is int
    assert all(records[i]['elapsed_ms']<=records[i+1]['elapsed_ms'] for i in range(len(records)-1))
    print(f'{s}: ok (exit={r.returncode}, records={len(records)})')
# Argument default remains normal.
default=subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(p)],capture_output=True,timeout=5)
assert default.returncode==0 and default.stdout==stdout_expected['normal']
assert [json.loads(x)['sequence'] for x in default.stderr.splitlines()]==[0,1,2]
print('default: ok')
